description: Preview updating a plugin that was added from the library to the latest version of its origin entry, changing nothing: the same result as library_merge_preview for that entry. Refused with code `library_update_no_origin` for a plugin that has no origin entry and `library_update_not_available` for one already at the latest version (plugins_list shows `libraryOrigin.updateAvailable`). `plugin` is required and is the plugin's exact, case-sensitive name, or its id with `pluginById: true` (see plugins_list); the installed plugin is never assumed.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin to act on, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin). Required.

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

name: library_update_preview
title: Preview library update
